description: Convert standard Microsoft WinForms controls (Button, DataGridView, TreeView, ListView, ComboBox, and others) to Telerik UI for WinForms equivalents — install the AllControls NuGet package, set up licensing, convert forms with the Telerik MCP migration tools, and apply a theme. Use to adopt Telerik UI for WinForms, or as a follow-up after telerik-winforms-version-upgrade or dotnet-version-upgrade.
